body.x: BF (CEO Jong-hwan Jeong, www.tg9plus.com) previewed its ULTRA TG9+, its smartphone glass protecting film that does not compromise visibility, at CES 2015, which will run Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The ULTRA TG9+ is a tempered glass protection film which maintains the visibility of the resolution, as well as its feel, for smartphone users. Its 9H surface hardness makes it ultra-resistant to scratches while its olephobic coating minimizes fingerprints and other surface marks. Its cross-section cutting process gives it a smooth feel without risk of any cuts and is designed to prevent shattering and shards even when the phone gets damaged.

Also on display will be BF's full cover which is designed for the curved display of the iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus. The simple design of the cover, made from tempered glass, traces the outline of the phone and features include an extraordinary feel for the user, olephobic coating, and shatter prevention. The full cover comes in three different types- clean, line, and free.

The ULTRA TG9+3D Revolution case comes in clear, jelly, and hard types and is melded with a 3D film providing different 3D patterns. In the case of the clear case, the Apple mark is engraved into the case for a simple but personal look.

A spokesperson for BF remarked, “Through the upcoming CES 2015 exhibition we plan to meet with a number of exporters to build up an overseas infrastructure to show our high quality tempered glass protection film to the global market.”

BF is a mobile phone accessory producer and has been involved in the smartphone screen and tempered glass film production and development. It has continued to expand its presence overseas including in the United States, Japan, and Europe.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
